note: Private RV park on the Ohio River near Smithland, west of Paducah. Sites 1-34 line the river; the inner row (35-57) and part of the river row are let by the month, so about 21 of 57 sites are sold by the night online. Boat dock and fishing pier, public boat ramp next door, firepit, playground, volleyball, basketball and horseshoes; dry cabins. Sites are restricted by rig type: the larger 50A river sites ask for rigs over 40 ft. --Claude

Year-round, full hookups 30/50A, Google 4.8/106.
